title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: when the marine pollutant surcharge is owed
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product the marine pollutant surcharge is written only for goods whose acceptance is marked marine pollutant. It is owed only while the acceptance is approved or loaded, and only once the booking carrying the goods is recorded as loaded, departed or closed. Goods not marked marine pollutant, goods whose booking shows any other status, and an acceptance that already carries a marine pollutant surcharge row owe no further marine pollutant surcharge; the amount is then 0.00. Where the charge is owed, the amount is stated to two decimal places.

## Truth table
| Marked marine pollutant | Acceptance approved or loaded | Booking loaded, departed or closed | Marine pollutant row already on the acceptance | Owed now |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | no | yes |
| yes | yes | yes | yes | no — 0.00 |
| yes | yes | no | — | no — 0.00 |
| yes | no | — | — | no — 0.00 |
| no | — | — | — | no — 0.00 |

The marking is read from the acceptance; the loading status is read from the record of the booking carrying the goods.

## Points of judgement
- *Does a hazardous-cargo surcharge row already on the acceptance stop the marine pollutant row?* No; the marine pollutant row is written in addition to it, and only an existing marine pollutant row stops a further one.
